coal_bush_ghost.description: Can be shaved for raw coal and more coal bush seeds.

coal_bush_seed_ghost.description: Can be planted to grow a coal bush that can be shaved for raw coal.

coal_bush_bud.description: Still just a bud sticking out of the ground. Hang in there, bud.

copper_ore.description: Melting down a full Copper Flower into raw ore.
copper_ore.flavor: First you craft the flower, now you melt it? Make up your mind...

tin_ore.description: Melting down a full Tin Flower into raw ore.
tin_ore.flavor: First you craft the flower, now you melt it? Make up your mind...

raw_coal.description: Melting down a bush of coal into a few lumps.
raw_coal.flavor: Careful to melt it and not stoke the fire with it...

iron_ore.description: Plenty of iron in this bush to melt down into a few raw ore.
iron_ore.flavor: First you craft the flower, now you melt it? Make up your mind...

silver_ore.description: You get enough pure silver for a single ore.
silver_ore.flavor: The Bush-to-Ore ratio seems a little off here...

gold_ore.description: Most of this bush is too impure to get a large amount of gold from melting it.
gold_ore.flavor: Liquidating assets in a whole new way...

natallium.description: This smaller flower only holds enough natallium to make one lump.
natallium.flavor: Good thing this stuff isn't used for anything important... is it?

coal_bush_seeds.flavor: CAUTION! Do not plant around naked flames!

copper_flower_seeds.description: A seed to grow your own copper ore plant!

gold_bush_seeds.flavor: Which I'm not entirely sure is legal...

iron_bush_seeds.description: The perfect bush for growing those big chunks of iron.
iron_bush_seeds.flavor: Probably best not to kick it...

silver_bush_seeds.description: A metallic bush that generates silver ore.
silver_bush_seeds.flavor: Wow, this thing must be worth a small fortune...

tin_flower_seeds.description: A seed to grow your own tin ore plant!
tin_flower_seeds.flavor: Won't be long before you have enough for a new roof...

natal_bell_seeds.description: Refining this mineral into a plant is tricky work!
natal_bell_seeds.flavor: Maybe a little too tricky...woops - Crystallium II on attempting the first infusion.
